# EN 16931 example invoices

The seventeen `.xml` files here are the UBL examples published with the EN 16931
validation artefacts, copied unmodified, names included:

- from <https://github.com/ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931>, directory `ubl/examples`
- at tag `validation-1.3.16`

They are **not** under this repository's MIT licence. They are licensed under the
European Union Public Licence 1.2, whose text is beside them in
`LICENSE-EUPL-1.2.txt`, as it is in the repository they come from.

They are here so that the reader and writer are held to documents this project
did not write. Nothing in `mockeinvoice/` is derived from them.
